defaultAppearance.assessment: Partitioning and reordering identical triangle attributes changes a small number of boundary pixels. Substituting the original GLB in the new application produces an exact R11 pixel match. This is a bounded rasterization difference, not an exact pixel match for the partitioned GLB.

limits: Casing and accessory shapes, fabric folds and finish remain under visual review.
Outline agreement from one panorama station does not establish real hull dimensions or hidden geometry.
SwiftShader checks establish correctness; they are not desktop/mobile hardware FPS results.
